artworks.title: Odysseus and Diomedes Steal the Bow of Heracles
artworks.description: Wertheimer's fetch from Lemnos — the craft and persuasion that brought the indispensable archer back to slay Paris before the safe Return to Italy.

artworks.title: Philoctetes on Lemnos
artworks.description: Lethière's wounded archer on the island — abandoned with Heracles' bow until the fetch that made his nostos to the Campanians possible.
